scripts.build: node scripts/db-provider.js && prisma generate && next build
scripts.build:lowmem: TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS=2 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2 NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 npm run build
scripts.start: node scripts/db-provider.js && prisma db push --accept-data-loss && tsx prisma/ensure-seed.ts && next start -H ${HOST:-0.0.0.0} -p ${PORT:-3000}
scripts.start:heroku: node scripts/db-provider.js && prisma db push --accept-data-loss && tsx prisma/ensure-seed.ts && next start
scripts.start:ukraine: node scripts/db-provider.js && prisma db push --accept-data-loss && tsx prisma/ensure-seed.ts && next start -H ${HOST:-0.0.0.0} -p ${PORT:-3000}
